349 distinct task IDs plus five non-task route keys describe all entries including held content. Original external quest IDs, shared recipients, instance phases, spell choices and zone crosslinks are not additional quests.

The Achievements subset has 291 authored/repaired source routes: 108 exact saved publication receipts, eleven Xorbb coherent-source summary records, and 172 older-overlay routes whose standalone commit receipts remain unresolved in this finite pass. These tiers are not interchangeable.
